name: Exterior Soffit Finish Coat 1
intent: Cut-in at junctions (qt_scaled) + field finish by method. 4 application methods. Coat 1 rates — coat 2 is ~10% faster in separate module.
doctrine: Soffit finish coat 1. Cut-in at fascia/frieze junctions (qt_scaled QT2:400, QT3:300, QT4:200). Brush/roll 120, spray 250, spray_backroll 200, spray_backbrush 180 (matches porch ceiling). Backroll uses whiz roller on handheld frame, not extension pole. Open-face modifier (2.0x) applies. No intercoat sanding on soffit. All overhead rates baked in.
